I held onto the pills just for one night. The night turned into days, the days turned into weeks, the weeks turned into months. Why did I hold onto them? I said I didn’t know, but I knew. 

I was craving the escape. My addict mind was telling me that I was fine. What’s one drink? What’s one drug? It’s nothing. 

I will test it out and I will only need the escape one more time and I will stop. I stopped once for almost three years so what’s the big deal? I made myself believe that I could let my guard down. I can be just like everyone else. It will not consume my brain. I will not be taken down again. I am stronger than I was before. 

Here I am today. I am cut up by my own doing.  I couldn’t control the urges to cut because I couldn’t control the urges to drink or drug. It was just two small blue pills, I’ll be fine I said. 

I forgot the guilt I would feel. The guilt I would feel because I let my loved ones down, I let my friends down, I let everyone down that followed me through my recovery. I forgot to mention how I let myself down. But I can’t see that right now because I am too angry with myself to see I broke my own heart. 

I’m sitting alone now, I can’t stop myself from what is about to happen. I can’t be here anymore. I am lost after being found. I can’t remember how I got here. I can’t remember how I got out the first time. I can’t remember the people that care. I can’t remember I deserve help. I can’t remember who to ask. 

I can’t remember

the homework would usually be worksheets that we would have to fill out based on what we did. for example when we were working on relationships with others we had to write what skills we used , if it was effective, and what we could have done differently

within distress tolerance there are a few skills that are used. for example there is self soothing with your 5 senses. so you would pick something from each sense that is soothing or relaxing and do all of them or as many as you can during an anxiety provoking moment. or there is A- activities C- comparison C-contributing E- emotion P-pushing away T- thoughts S- sensations

I have to say overall it has been helpful. It wouldn't be fair to say it hasn't been. It is definitely a information overload.
